results.name: Direct LLM (No Retrieval)
results.description: Generates answers directly without external knowledge retrieval.

results.name: Sparse-Only Retrieval
results.description: BM25 lexical retrieval with medical tokenization (k=3).

results.name: Hybrid Retrieval (RRF)
results.description: Reciprocal Rank Fusion combining dense & sparse retrieval.

results.name: Hybrid + Query Expansion
results.description: Hybrid retrieval enriched with medical synonym expansion.

results.name: Hybrid + Reranking & Diversity
results.description: Hybrid retrieval with cross-encoder reranking and deduplication.

results.name: Full Multi-Agent Pipeline
results.description: Query Understanding -> Hybrid Retrieval -> Rerank -> Gen -> Verification.

results.name: Multi-Agent + Refusal Guard
results.description: Full pipeline with controlled abstention on emergencies, injections & ungrounded queries.

results.name: Full Multi-Agent + Numerical Consistency
results.description: End-to-end multi-agent system with unit-normalized numerical verification and conflict aggregation.
